items.text: THIS WAS ONCE THE CHAPEL OF THE KEEP. INSIDE THE DOORWAY ARE THE DRIED HUSKS OF TWO ORCS, THEIR FACES TWISTED WITH TERROR. A LARGE ALTAR DOMINATES THE SOUTHERN WALL.
items.direction: ominous, wary fantasy narration; vivid but controlled

items.text: THE OUTLINE OF A SAD-FACED MAN WAVERS AND FADES AWAY.
THE SHAPE SPEAKS, 'I AM THE LIFE FORM OF FERRAN MARTINEZ, BOUND WITH THE UNDEAD SPIRITS OF ALL WHO DIE WITHIN THESE WALLS TO GUARD THE KEEP. TELL ME, HAS THE CITY BEEN FREED?'
items.direction: measured narration for the attribution, then perform Ferran in a low, weary, honorable spirit's voice; solemn and emotionally alive

items.text: 'YOU LIE,' THE SPIRIT MOANS AS IT FADES AWAY.
items.direction: perform Ferran as wounded and weary, then return to somber narration for the fade

items.text: FERRAN SPEAKS: 'THE CITY FELL LONG AGO TO THE UNBLESSED CREATURES IMBUED WITH THE MIGHT OF A MAGICAL POOL. CHIEF AMONG THESE WERE TYRANTHRAXUS, EDRANKA, AND TORATH. WITH THEIR POWERS THEY RULED AND UNITED ALL ELSE, DRIVING FORWARD TO DESTROY US ALL. THE SAGE MENDOR WORKED HARD TO GATHER RECORD OF ALL THESE THINGS, BUT THEY ARE LOST NOW, HIS LIBRARY OVERRUN.
items.direction: brief measured attribution, then Ferran's same low, weary, honorable spirit voice; grave historical testimony with rising urgency

items.text: TO FIND HELP FOR YOUR BATTLES, YOU SHOULD PASS THROUGH THE ILLUSIONARY WALL IN THE ARMORY OF THIS KEEP.
items.direction: Ferran's low, weary, honorable spirit voice; direct helpful counsel

items.text: TO PASS MY GUARDS ON THE WAY OUT, SPEAK THE WORD 'SAMOSUD'. NOW WE ARE FREED, OUR DUTY DONE!' FERRAN FADES AWAY.
items.direction: Ferran's low, weary, honorable spirit voice, ending with solemn release; return to narrator for the final fade
